messages:
maria: Quick Q — who can flip the emergency toggle for prod 'serve.enable_magic'? we're seeing a canary at 15% with tail latency climbing. Need clarity before I ask SRE to act.

ajay: Authorized groups: team:eng-oncall, team:eng-platform-sre, and role:infra-ops. Product-ops is NOT in the ACL. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kill-switches

sam: We granted a temporary exception to the ml-release lead last month (ticket RDW-4123). Is that still intended? cc @jess

jess: No — let's revoke that exception. Escalation must go through oncall, not an individual PO. I'll open a config PR to remove the exception today.

maria: Thanks. Also what's the canonical flow (CLI vs Console) so audit entries are consistent?

ops-bot: Note: toggles flipped via Console UI include automatic audit metadata. CLI flips require the --audit-note flag to attach a reason.

ajay: ```
redwoodctl feature toggle disable serve.enable_magic --env prod --scope rollout:canary=15% --audit-note "Disabling canary after latency spike"
```

deploy-bot: When a prod toggle is changed we auto-create a toggle-action event and post to #incidents. Example audit line: `user=ajay action=disable feature=serve.enable_magic env=prod event_id=evt_61b9b2 ts=2087654325`

jess: :memo: After a flip, please add a short note to the incident thread and tag the release owner. If errors >5% we want a 48h RCA.

sam: If someone flips it, paste the event_id here so we can correlate server logs and traces. Also double-check KV cache priming before re-enable.

maria: Got it. I'll wait for oncall confirmation and then ask SRE to flip if needed. Thanks :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Policy check: current rotation 'infra-oncall' is authorized. For emergency override, ping @eng-platform on PagerDuty and obtain one approver. Overrides are logged and require a follow-up ticket.

jess: PR to revoke ml-release exception: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/+/PR-2847 — ETA merge EOD.

ajay: I'll add an automated check to flag any mismatched ACLs on toggles so exceptions don't persist.

maria: leaving this open until the PR lands and oncall confirms. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
